My bank (Community First) is smaller than most in my region of SC. I also have a credit union account. But only keep a couple hundred dollars in there. 
My work direct deposit goes to my main bank (Comm. First).

Question; Is the credit union any "safer" than a regular bank ??
I was wondering if I should transfer most, or half, or some more to the credit union. 
The past 3 weeks, I've taken out smaller lots of $500-$1,000 several times, to just keep in my safe at home.
But, like most people..., I pay basically ALL my bills online, with the funds coming out of the regular bank accounts. So I obviously have to maintain enough in there at all times to cover my monthly bills (which come due at different times).

So.., better/safer option.., 
Regular (small) bank 
- OR - 
Credit Union ???
